name: Chicken coop relocation and electric fence setup

mentions.name: Chicken coop relocation and electric fence setup
mentions.description: This DIY homestead project relocates a chicken coop that had sunk into a waterlogged low spot: a patch of drier ground was cleared, four piers were set and leveled for the coop to sit on, and the coop was slid a few hundred feet across the lawn on salvaged composite deck boards and landed atop the new piers. An electric fence was put back up to keep bears out, and trees felled to clear the spot were bucked into firewood.
mentions.problem: The chicken coop had sunk halfway into the ground after being unknowingly sited in a soggy low spot, and bears threatened the coop until the electric fence was reinstalled.
mentions.source_excerpt: Earlier today? My partner and I felled a couple of trees and bucked them into firewood to clear a spot on drier ground for our chicken coop, which had sunk halfway to China because we unknowingly landed it in a soup bowl three years ago when we moved in the winter when the ground was frozen. Also set and leveled four piers in the new spot for it to sit on.
